About us

Our history

Since 1999, Catcha Group has been building and backing category-defining businesses across Southeast Asia. We have a proven history of seeing opportunities early, moving fast, and executing with discipline — from launching market-leading platforms to taking companies public. Over two decades, we've operated through every market cycle, scaling ideas into industry leaders and building a reputation for turning bold visions into real outcomes.

Working with founders

  • Principal-led. A family office run by its principals, so you deal directly with the people who decide.
  • Our own capital. We invest our own money in every deal and stand shoulder-to-shoulder with the teams we back.
  • Hands-on. We work side by side with founders to unlock growth, sharpen strategy and build long-term value.

We only bet where we are willing to put our own money, energy and expertise on the line.
